item.title: Temple Architectural Design
item.description: Looking up into the jaguar's mouth at the entrance. A commissioned temple design, modelled in Maya and explored as a walkable real-time VR simulation in Unreal Engine. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.

item.description: An early test projection on the miniature scale model, making sure everything worked well.
